subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Match a counsellor's advice to teenagers' problems
Proofread and edit an informal letter
Plan a letter to a problem page

tf.s: A counsellor gives advice to people with problems.
tf.why: Yes! Teens can write to a counsellor for help.

tf.s: 'Give yourself more time to decide' goes with Letter C (Munira).
'Set yourself time limits for your homework tasks' goes with Letter A (Nabil).
'Why don't you just watch your friends play?' goes with Letter A.
Proofreading means looking for errors; editing means correcting them.
tf.why: Good! First find mistakes, then fix them.

tf.s: 'Take care, speak soon' goes at the beginning of a letter.
tf.why: It is a closing phrase, so it goes at the end.

tf.s: 'PS' is an extra message written after you sign your name.
In a correction code, 'sp' means spelling.
tf.why: Right! 'p' is punctuation and 'gr' is grammar.

tf.s: 'Self-esteem' means the feeling that you have no value.
tf.why: Self-esteem is the feeling that you are a person of value or worth.

mcq.q: Which advice sentence goes with Letter A?
o: Why don't you just watch your friends play?
Give yourself more time to decide.

mcq.q: Which is a good opening sentence for a letter to a problem page about homework?
o: I'm writing to you about a very worrying problem with my homework.
PS I forgot to tell you.
mcq.why: The opening should explain why you are writing.

mcq.q: Which piece of advice would also suit Taha?
o: Turn off your phone while you study.
Go to bed at three o'clock.
mcq.why: Taha's advice is about managing homework time.

mcq.q: Which phrase can go at the end of an informal letter?
mcq.why: Closing phrases go at the end.

mcq.q: Why does 'Try and introduce your friends to another sport' suit Nabil?
o: He does not enjoy football and makes mistakes, so another sport may suit him
mcq.why: The advice matches his problem with football.

mcq.q: What makes a piece of advice useful?
o: It is about a different problem
mcq.why: Good advice suits the problem in the letter.

mcq.q: Why do counsellors often use imperatives like 'Give yourself more time'?
o: They tell the person clearly what to do
